lines.en: label norikosummer2conveniencegen:
scene norikosummer2conveniencegen
Once again, I find myself tucked deep into the heart of the second half of town, wasting away my night in an old convenience store with a girl who likes me far more than she should.
lines.zh: 又一次，我发现自己缩在城镇后半部的最深处，在一家老旧的便利店里，和一个对我的喜欢远远超过应有程度的女孩一起消磨夜晚。

lines.en: As always, things are pretty calm around here, with an influx of customers so minute that it’s like no one ever shows up at all.
lines.zh: 和往常一样，这里相当安静，客流稀微得就像从来没有人来过一样。

lines.en: Noriko spends the night talking about precious memories from her past and I spend the night wishing I could talk about that too.
lines.zh: Noriko 整晚都在讲她过去那些珍贵的回忆，而我整晚都在希望自己也能讲点什么。

lines.en: Instead, I stand there like a sponge, absorbing information that leaked out of me a long time ago and hoping that there will be more memories for her to gleefully look back on in the future.
lines.zh: 相反，我像块海绵一样站在那里，吸收那些很久以前从我身上漏出去的信息，盼着未来她还能有更多可以欣喜回望的回忆。

lines.en: But I know better than most that things like that won’t happen so long as I’m around.
lines.zh: 但我比大多数人都清楚，只要有我在，那样的事就不会发生。

lines.en: scene black
If I could strip away her memories and replace them with ones aimed at someone else, I would.
lines.zh: 如果我能剥走她的记忆、换成指向别人的记忆，我会做的。

lines.en: If I could rid her of her lingering feelings and years worth of unrequited love, I would.
lines.zh: 如果我能让她摆脱那些挥之不去的情感、还有长年累月的单恋，我会做的。

lines.en: There are many, many things that I would do if only I could find the strength or resolve required to act.
lines.zh: 有太多太多的事，只要我能找到行动所需的气力或决心，我都会去做。

lines.en: And while my acting skills in terms of the masks that I can wear may be among the best, it does not change my inability to fulfill a role I do not understand.
lines.zh: 虽然我戴面具的演技大概算得上数一数二，但这改变不了我无力扮演一个我并不理解的角色。

lines.en: And so I continue to stand there and I continue to listen- but I leave with almost nothing.
lines.zh: 于是我继续站在那里，继续听着——可离开时几乎两手空空。

lines.en: And everything I managed to absorb in those several hours stationary leaks out again once the moonlight hits my skin.
lines.zh: 而我在那几个小时里一动不动所吸收的一切，一旦月光落到我皮肤上，就又漏了个干净。
